name: A Peace of Soul Vegan Kitchen
sourceName: WIS News 10: A Peace of Soul vegan restaurant closes in Columbia
ownershipEvidence: QCity Metro’s Black-owned business feature included A Peace of Soul. Its official site published the address but announced a June 13 farewell service; WIS reported on June 13, 2026 that it had closed.
notes: HELD: source evidence reports closure, and it was not clear whether or where the restaurant planned to reopen. Do not promote as current.

name: Cakes LaMo’r Bakery
sourceName: Cakes LaMo’r Bakery official Facebook page
ownershipEvidence: Experience Columbia’s Black-Owned Businesses guide included Cakes LaMo’r. The official Facebook page presents the business as a Columbia bakery and states in a recent update that Mrs. Rosa stepped back from running the business and takes limited personal orders.
notes: HELD: current official page does not publish a numbered physical street address, and the status update makes it inappropriate to promote the older tourism-listing storefront address as current. This is not classified as online-only because its operating model/location is not established.
